introduction.title: Many models. One workspace.
paragraphs: vminds Solo is an AI aggregator that brings more than 200 models into one workspace. Users can chat with models and work across image, video, music, and other categories, then go further by creating custom agents and building workflows.

My contribution focused on UX design, frontend development, and deployment on AWS and Azure. The frontend brings model discovery, conversations, agent configuration, and a visual workflow builder into a consistent, multilingual interface.

solution.title: The solution
paragraphs: Solo connects model discovery with practical ways to use AI. A toolbox provides a starting point for finding a model and opening a session, while a custom agent library lets users define reusable assistants with their own personality, language, and response style.

Agents can also become building blocks in a visual workflow. Users connect steps on a canvas, create branching paths, and run the workflow with a prompt, bringing repeatable multi-step tasks into the same workspace as individual conversations.
